newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares open with a whimper, trading flat.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares open with a whimper, trading flat.

text.p: Singapore shares started a new trading month with a whimper on Monday with dealers expecting the flat start to typify the weeks ahead.
"They say 'sell in May and go away', well that's what the buyers seem to have done," a dealer at a local insitution said.
"Things are moving slowly today and market prices are reflecting the lack of interest," another dealer said.
At 0215 GMT the barometer Straits Times Industrials Index was almost unchanged, off 0.56 points at 2,064.92.
Early marketwide volume was 26.1 million shares with losers edging out gainers 68 to 82.
Dealers said activity in off market crossed deals was high and included the cross of 1.2 million shares in Hongkong Land Holdings at prices between US$2.67 and US$2.68.
Foreign share tranches led early gainers with Singapore Press foreign gaining Singapore $0.60 to S$29.10 and Singapore Airlines foreign making up for some of last week's fall, up S$0.40 to S$12.60.
Perennial see-saw share Creative Technology headed the list of early losers, down S$1.30 to S$25.20.
